remove_definitions(-D_WIN32_WINNT=0x502)
add_definitions(-D_WIN32_WINNT=0x600)

add_definitions(
    -D_ATL_VER=_ATL_VER_30)

spec2def(atl.dll atl.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

add_idl_reg_objects(atl registry atl_classes.idl)
add_idl_reg_objects(atl regtypelib atl_lib.idl)

# atl.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/atl-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
# Generated inputs those compiles read, ordered before them.
add_library(atl_shims OBJECT atl.c atl30.c atl_ax.c registrar.c)
target_link_libraries(atl_shims PRIVATE uuid wine wine_dll_register wine_dll_canunload oldnames liboleaut32 libole32 libuser32 libgdi32 libadvapi32 libadvapi32_vista libshlwapi libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
set_wine_module_fixme(atl_shims)
add_dependencies(atl_shims stdole2)
set(ATL_REUSED
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/dll/win32/atl/atl_classes_r.o
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/dll/win32/atl/atl_lib_t.o)
add_cargo_module(atl atl-cargo atl.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS atl_shims atl_r atl_t ${ATL_REUSED} psdk uuid_sources)
